test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A man invested a sum of ₹5,000 on simple interest for 5 years such that the rate of interest for the first 2 years is 10% per annum, for the next 3 years it is 12% per annum How much interest (in ₹), will he earn at the end of 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5,000

Time for first period (t₁) = 2 years

Rate for first period (r₁) = 10% per annum

Time for second period (t₂) = 3 years

Rate for second period (r₂) = 12% per annum

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P times (r times t)/(100)
